producer_report.summary: I added an empty-grant [capabilities.study] table to athena.toml, placed after the change capability's checks and before [classes]. It sets producer_commands = {} and verifier_commands = {}, with a comment saying it is the study capability's first configuration, grants no commands yet, and that pinning the study source comes in a later job. No other part of athena.toml changed, no Rust file changed, and CHANGELOG.md is unchanged. clippy and fmt pass. cargo test --locked fails in one test: athena-cap-study's the_verifier_never_writes_and_nothing_is_configured_yet asserts that study has no config section (lib.rs:164-165). That assertion is now false. Fixing it needs a Rust test edit, which the brief forbids, so I left it and am reporting it instead of routing around the rule.

checks_run.note: FAILS. 30 athena-agent, 2 athena-cap-change and 27 of 28 athena-cap-study tests pass. The failure is athena-cap-study tests::the_verifier_never_writes_and_nothing_is_configured_yet, which asserts at crates/athena-cap-study/src/lib.rs:165 that jc.config.capability("study") is None, with the comment 'The capability is not in athena.toml'. The new [capabilities.study] table makes that assertion false. The test is in Rust source, which criterion 2 and the out-of-scope list forbid me to change. athena.toml itself parses: the athena-data config tests and the athena-cli wiring test ran before the athena-cap-study failure stopped the run, and the failing test's own jc.config load succeeded.

open_issues: cargo test --locked fails (criterion 3). The cause is the stale assertion at crates/athena-cap-study/src/lib.rs:164-165, which I was not allowed to change. Either that assertion is updated in a Rust change (for example, asserting the study section is present with empty grants), or this job's scope is widened to allow that one-line test edit.
CHANGELOG.md is unchanged. The deliverables list names it, but the existing Unreleased entry is still accurate, so I judged that no edit is needed. If Athena wants an entry anyway, it can be added.
mistakes: I did not check the whole test suite for a test that depends on the absence of the study section before editing athena.toml. A grep for capability("study") or the words 'not in athena.toml' would have shown the stale assertion first.
learnings: CapabilityConfig in crates/athena-data/src/config.rs requires producer_commands and verifier_commands and denies unknown fields; env and checks default to empty.
The study capability is registered in crates/athena-cli/src/wiring.rs (capabilities() returns Change and Study), so the reader can pick it once athena.toml has a [capabilities.study] table.
crates/athena-cap-study/src/lib.rs has a test (the_verifier_never_writes_and_nothing_is_configured_yet) that assumes study has no athena.toml section. It is the only test this change breaks.
CHANGELOG.md's Unreleased 'Added' entry already says the reader can pick study and that it has no configured checks or commands yet. That stays true after this change.
desires: Permission to change the one stale assertion at crates/athena-cap-study/src/lib.rs:164-165 (the 'not in athena.toml' check), or a decision that a Rust test edit belongs to this job. The brief forbids Rust changes, so I left it alone.
A way to run only the athena-data config tests and the athena-cli wiring test, so the parse check could be shown to pass in isolation (cargo test -p athena-data -p athena-cli, for example).
